name: Smart Conversion Tracker
author: hasanmatubber15

sections.description:
Smart Conversion Tracker helps you install Facebook Pixel on your WordPress site with one click. It tracks page views and helps you build audiences for your ads.

Upgrade to Pro for Advanced Features:
For professional marketers, we recommend Smart Conversion Tracker Pro.

Pro Features:
* Facebook Conversion API (CAPI) support.
* iOS 14+ Tracking Fix.
* Precise WooCommerce Purchase Tracking.
* Domain-locked license for security.

For support or custom development, contact me on Telegram: https://t.me/hasanmatubber
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to ‘SCT Free’ and enter your Pixel ID.
sections.faq:
Does it support Conversion API?

The free version supports Browser Pixel. For Conversion API (CAPI), please upgrade to the Pro version.
